summary: Achieved 1.0% improvement over baseline (1.012347 → 1.001943) by increasing model depth from 8 to 10 layers. Initial experiments with lower embedding LR and higher matrix LR degraded performance. Depth increases to 11 and 12 exceeded VRAM constraints. The optimal configuration balances model capacity with 5-minute training window, allowing depth=10 to achieve better convergence than the baseline while staying within the 79GB H100 VRAM limit.
